tagline: Air Nomad mobility — Momo slips into any space, Appa looms over two zones, and every shared space pays out

featuredCards.title: Team Avatar
featuredCards.caption: The setup: shuffle every fighter on the board, park Momo beside anyone — friend or foe — and take the extra action.

featuredCards.title: Yip Yip!
featuredCards.caption: The engine: a cheap swing that repositions your other fighter and refunds the action, so Momo is never out of reach.

featuredCards.title: Air Nomads
featuredCards.caption: The payoff: trap the opposing fighter inside one of your fighters' zones and this 3 becomes a 5 — plus Appa's +1 when he out-covers them.

featuredCards.title: Hallucinations
featuredCards.caption: The twist: your attack, their defender. Pick which of their fighters takes the hit — the defense they committed stays on the table.
